quotes.text: With delegation semantics, principal A still has its own identity separate from B, and it is explicitly understood that while B may have delegated some of its rights to A, any actions taken are being taken by A representing B.
When principal A impersonates principal B, A is given all the rights that B has within some defined rights context and is indistinguishable from B in that context.
